          Planning your trip to this vibrant city is a breeze with Saudia Airlines. You'll find it easy to book your flight to Istanbul (IST), with a variety of flight times to fit your schedule. Our world-class service will make your journey comfortable and memorable.

          Flight arrivals at Ataturk Airport (IST)

          When you land at Ataturk Airport (IST) in Istanbul, you’ll be greeted by a welcoming and well-organized terminal that ensures a smooth arrival experience. Ataturk Airport offers a wide range of passenger services to make your arrival in Istanbul pleasant and convenient. Whether you’re continuing your travels or exploring Istanbul for the first time, Ataturk Airport provides everything you need to start your visit comfortably.

           

          Bridge Two Worlds in Istanbul: Where Continents and Cultures Converge

          Step into a city where continents collide and vibrant cultures unite. Istanbul invites you on an unforgettable journey across the blue waters of the Bosphorus, connecting Europe and Asia. Feel the energy of bustling historic markets, experience timeless wellness traditions, and watch the sun set over a magnificent skyline. Your extraordinary adventure begins in this dynamic crossroads of the world.


          1. Cruise The Bosphorus Strait

          Sail between two continents and take in stunning waterfront views where Europe meets Asia. Feel the refreshing sea breeze as you glide past historic mansions and beautiful palaces. This unique waterway offers an unparalleled perspective of the city, perfectly capturing the vibrant energy of a metropolis divided by water but united in spirit.


          2. Get Lost In The Grand Bazaar

          Wander through thousands of lively shops to find hand-woven carpets, colorful lamps, and unique souvenirs. Bright lanterns illuminate the historic pathways, creating a magical atmosphere for every traveler. Engage with welcoming local merchants, practice your bargaining skills, and discover exceptional treasures hidden within one of the largest covered markets in the world.


          3. Experience Flavors At The Spice Bazaar

          Feast your senses on exotic herbs, rich Turkish coffee, and sweet treats in a historic setting. Let the intense aromas guide you through rows of vibrant stalls filled with colorful spices and traditional delicacies. Taste authentic Turkish delight and select premium ingredients that bring the true essence of local culinary history straight to your palate.


          4. Relax In A Traditional Hammam

          Pamper yourself with an authentic steam bath and scrub to feel fully refreshed and energized. Enter a peaceful sanctuary of warm marble and soothing steam designed to wash away all your travel fatigue. This ancient self-care ritual revitalizes your body and mind, offering a deeply relaxing escape from the fast pace of the city.


          5. Walk Across Galata Bridge

          Join local fishermen, snack on fresh street food, and watch a breathtaking golden sunset over the iconic city skyline. Walk above the bustling waters of the Golden Horn as boats pass beneath you. Enjoy a popular local fish sandwich while the sky transforms into a brilliant display of warm colors.
